ValidationRule.description: OPS-240. Blocks Closed Won when a practice-level Account has an incomplete Shipping Address. Scoped to Account_Level__c = Practice because hardware ships to a clinic, not a corp. Inert while the field is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), TEXT(Account.Account_Level__c) = "Practice", OR( ISBLANK(Account.ShippingStreet), ISBLANK(Account.ShippingCity), ISBLANK(Account.ShippingState), ISBLANK(Account.ShippingPostalCode) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot mark Closed Won: the Account is missing a complete Shipping Address (Street, City, State and/or Zip). Add it on the Close screen, or update the Account directly.
